title: Feature request : button to "clean" main graph
body:
Sometimes, the main graph is so filled with different informations that the BG curve is not easy to see.

If possible, it would be nice to have a _tick box_ that toggles between main BG view with carbs and insulin vs the actual graph with all the information on it.

![Screenshot_20211109-074035_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/141339110-3d44186f-dae6-40ac-8d64-a6b3af4e9a4c.jpg)
